يستحثا (form X)
# يَسْتَحِثَّا (yastaḥiṯṯā) /jas.ta.ħiθ.θaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
# يُسْتَحَثَّا (yustaḥaṯṯā) /jus.ta.ħaθ.θaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
